review_locator: PMCID:PMC4422082, Interactions between Hyaluronan and Its Receptors; PMID:38638002, CD44 and RHAMM are Microenvironmental Sensors
primary_title: Identification of a common hyaluronan binding motif in the hyaluronan binding proteins RHAMM, CD44 and link protein
decision_basis: The reviews identify RHAMM/HMMR as a hyaluronan-binding receptor and cite primary biochemical studies mapping its carboxyl-terminal hyaluronan-binding domains and essential basic-residue motifs.
limitations_preserved: Preserve RHAMM/HMMR isoform, extracellular-versus-intracellular localization, cooperative CD44 context, and injury/cancer model boundaries; direct binding only, with no universal signaling or SCI inference.
